sections.title: Learning Objective
sections.content: I can use the facts that angles on a straight line sum to 180° and angles at a point sum to 360°.

sections.title: Key Words
sections.content:
straight line -- Angles on a straight line add up to 180°. Angles at a point add up to 360°.
point -- Angles on a straight line add up to 180°. Angles at a point add up to 360°.

sections.title: Method
sections.content:
Straight line = 180°. Full turn = 360°. Vertically opposite = equal.
a + b = 180° (on a line); a + b + c + d = 360° (at a point)
Two fundamental angle facts

Key examples:
  ✓ Angles on a straight line = 180°  (half turn)
  ✓ Angles at a point = 360°  (full turn)
  ✓ Vertically opposite angles are equal  (X-shape)
  ✗ Angles on a line sum to 360°  (should be 180°)
  ✗ Vertically opposite angles sum to 180°  (they are equal)

sections.title: Worked Example
sections.content:
Example 1 – angles on a straight line
  Angles of 110° and x are on a straight line. Find x.
  Angles on a straight line = 180°
  110 + x = 180
  x = 180 − 110 = 70°
  x = 70°
  (Subtract the known angle from 180°.)

Example 2 – three angles on a line
  Three angles on a straight line are 40°, 85° and x. Find x.
  40 + 85 + x = 180
  125 + x = 180
  x = 55°
  x = 55°
  (Add the known angles, then subtract from 180°.)

sections.title: Two angles on a straight line
sections.content:
Find x.

(a) x and 130°
(b) x and 45°
(c) x and 90°
(d) x and 167°

sections.title: Vertically opposite
sections.content:
Two lines cross. One angle is given. Find the other three.

(a) 40°
(b) 72°
(c) 115°
(d) 90°

sections.title: Mixed problems
sections.content:
Find x. State which rule you used.

(a) 2x and 3x on a straight line
(b) x, 2x, 3x at a point
(c) 4x − 10 and 2x + 40 on a line
(d) Vertically opposite: 3x + 5 = 50
(e) x + 20, 2x + 10, x + 30 on a line

sections.title: Common Mistakes
sections.content:
✓ Angles on a straight line add to 180°
✗ Angles at a point add to 180°
✓ Vertically opposite angles are equal
✗ A straight line has an angle of 360°
✗ When two lines cross, all four angles are equal
